title: Plans and billing
text:
There are three plans: Starter, Team, and Business. Starter is free for one user.

Team costs $12 per user per month billed annually, or $15 billed monthly.

Business adds single sign-on, audit logs, and a 99.9% uptime commitment.

title: Refunds
text:
Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase.

After 14 days we refund the unused months as account credit, not cash.

Monthly plans are not refunded, but you can cancel any time and keep access until the period ends.

title: Cancelling your subscription
text:
Owners can cancel from Settings, then Billing, then Cancel plan.

Your data stays available read-only for 30 days after cancellation, then it is deleted permanently.

Export anything you need before the 30 days run out.

title: Exporting your data
text:
Use Settings, then Data, then Export to download every invoice and client as CSV.

Large accounts get an email with a download link when the export is ready, usually within an hour.

Exports include attachments as a separate ZIP archive.

title: Single sign-on
text:
Single sign-on with SAML 2.0 is available on the Business plan.

We support Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace as identity providers.

Once SSO is enforced, password logins are disabled for everyone except the account owner.

title: Two-factor authentication
text:
Turn on two-factor authentication under Profile, then Security.

We support authenticator apps and hardware security keys. Text message codes are not supported.

If you lose your device, use one of the ten recovery codes shown when you enabled it.

title: Resetting your password
text:
Click Forgot password on the sign-in page and we email a reset link.

The link expires after 60 minutes and works once.

If no email arrives, check spam and confirm you used the address on your account.

title: Recurring invoices
text:
Recurring invoices are sent automatically on a schedule you choose: weekly, monthly, or yearly.

Each run creates a new invoice number and emails the client.

Pause a schedule at any time without deleting past invoices.

title: Late payment fees
text:
You can add a late fee as a fixed amount or a percentage of the balance.

Fees are applied once, the day after the due date, and appear as a new line item.

Clients see the fee on the invoice and in the reminder email.

title: Multiple currencies
text:
Invoices can be issued in over 30 currencies.

Exchange rates for reports are taken from the European Central Bank daily reference rates.

The currency of an invoice cannot be changed after it is sent.

title: Sales tax and VAT
text:
Add tax rates under Settings, then Taxes. Each line item can carry up to two taxes.

For EU VAT reverse charge, mark the client as a business and enter their VAT number.

Tax totals appear separately on the invoice and in the tax report.

title: Stripe payments
text:
Connect Stripe to let clients pay invoices by card.

Payouts go straight to your Stripe account; we never hold funds.

Stripe processing fees are charged by Stripe, not by us.

title: API rate limits
text:
The REST API allows 600 requests per minute per account.

Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

Business accounts can ask support for a higher limit.

title: Team roles and permissions
text:
There are three roles: Owner, Admin, and Member.

Members can create invoices but cannot see billing or delete clients.

Only the Owner can transfer ownership or cancel the subscription.
